title: Terebinthine
summary: TEREBIN'THINE, adjective [Latin terebinthinus, from terebinthina, turpentine.] Pertaining to turpentine; consisting of turpentine, or partaking of its qualities.

inlines.v: TEREBIN'THINE, adjective [Latin terebinthinus, from terebinthina, turpentine.] Pertaining to turpentine; consisting of turpentine, or partaking of its qualities.
